items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: And they played it with Al Rinker, Mildred Bailey's brother, and the Rhythm Boys. [Bing]

ctx.x: So I'll never forget it. And I want to tell you their reaction and how nice they were. Well, my brother says, 'You know,' he says, 'if we could just get in and hear Paul Whiteman band,' he says, 'man,' he said, 'I know there's going to be some beautiful music played.' He didn't play the jazz, the band wasn't a jazz band. But Bix and -- he broke it down like Basie used to do, the Kansas City Six and the Kansas City Seven, you understand? And they played it with Al Rinker, Mildred Bailey's brother, and the Rhythm…
